Sample.evidence_source: Results of independent samples t-tests showed no significant differences between Malay and Chinese participants on either of the factor scores: General Body Appreciation (Malay M = 3.63, SD = .86, \alpha = .95; Chinese M = 3.73, SD = .85, \alpha = .95), t(589) = 1.40, p > .05, and; Body Image Investment (Malay M = 3.45, SD = .98, \alpha = .74; Chinese M = 3.46, SD = .97, \alpha = .71), t(589) = 1.01, p > .05. The degrees of freedom for an independent samples t-test are N-2, so 589 = N-2, which means N = 591 for Study X.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results of independent samples t-tests conducted to examine between-group differences in BAS Factor Scores (General Body Appreciation and Body Image Investment) between Malay and Chinese participants. The analyses, which involved a total sample of 591 participants, revealed no significant differences between the two ethnic groups on either factor score in Study X.
